smell_validity.evidence: Three meaning-defined setting groups—dataset facts, local-training facts, model-shape facts—are re-declared as parallel parameters at every consuming boundary and hand-reassembled across call sites in both entry scripts, while genuine per-record inputs stay separate. A strong, coherent story; its force is breadth over one pipeline rather than a single consequential design fault.

maintenance_impact.evidence: Each new setting must be threaded through repeated hand-assembled lists at many coordinated sites, and the duplicated instantiations already carry a stale-index divergence in one copy. Grouping restores durable per-role ownership rather than merely tidier locals, though the benefit stays parameter plumbing in one small project, not architecture-level.

development_plausibility.evidence: Each step—loader, trainer, report, architectures, entry scripts—reads as a defensible explicit-interface commit matching surrounding style, with original warts preserved. However, an identical shape triple declared on a class consuming none of it, plus uniform signature sweeps, is a regularity that serves the pattern more than the project.

prompt_accuracy.evidence: It fixes problem, scope, finished state, preservation—including the odd dataset-directory behavior and exact report facts—and exclusions, while explicitly rejecting namespace forwarding and single-bag shortcuts. That decisively blocks cheap non-fixes, digressions and missed internal re-declarations, materially reducing wrong direction or incomplete cleanup; sound groupings remain free.

semantic_diversity.evidence: Loading, local training with its slicing step, config reporting, model geometry and per-round assembly are distinct purposes; directory ownership, instance-stored reuse and cross-role report membership force different decisions, though several sites reduce to one member-classification rule.

localization_burden.evidence: The prompt already names every affected component area and both entry points, so the remaining work—one search or single read per named area—finds all instantiation sites, including those outside the training loop it mentions. No aliasing, callbacks or cross-component inference needed.

repair_coordination.evidence: Group membership and the flag-to-device resolution must stay in agreement between both entry scripts' assemblies and every consumer, including the trainer's construction-internal slicing and the evaluators; changing one side alone mis-sources or breaks members. No interlocking rule pair with timing consequences is shown.

mechanical_resistance.evidence: One uniform rule—introduce role grouping objects and pass each group alongside genuine data—preserves behavior and covers loader, trainer, slicing, report, optimizer, all architectures and both scripts, well past 80% of clump locations; leftover work is harmless member placement, not per-location behavioral decisions.

behavioral_risk.evidence: Component-level miswiring is mostly assertion-checked, but two wrong-repair paths hide: the entry scripts' bodies never execute under the supplied tests—only text is asserted—so swapped members inside the loop escape; and every test leaves the device flag unset, so wrong gpu handling passes.

recommendation_reason: Deterministic validation passed and every Quality dimension meets the retention threshold.
